text: In California, you can still register and vote on Election Day itself.
seenIn: a group chat, after the deadline passed

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Same Day Voter Registration
truthSource.oneLine: After the regular deadline (15 days out), you can still register and vote through Election Day at a county elections office or vote center. The ballot counts once the county verifies you.

lesson.tip: “Registration closed” usually means the regular deadline, not the last chance. Before you tell a friend it’s too late, check the Secretary of State’s same-day registration page.
